name: How do I choose the right contractor for my condo remodel?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my condo remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right contractor involves several key steps. Look for licensed and insured contractors with specific experience in condo remodels, as these projects have unique challenges like HOA rules and shared walls. Request references and review portfolios of past work. Obtain detailed bids from multiple contractors and compare not just price, but also scope of work, timeline, and communication style. A reliable contractor should be transparent, communicative, and willing to answer all your questions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a condo remodel contractor by verifying licenses/insurance, checking references/portfolios, comparing detailed bids, and prioritizing clear communication and specific condo experience.
